  • Method Details

    • setSender

      public static Consumer<GestureStatePkt> setSender(Consumer<GestureStatePkt> sender)
      Installs the loader packet sender and resets synchronization so the next state sync sends even unchanged mode/modifier state. Does not change the selected mode.
      Parameters:
      sender - sender to install, or null to clear it; syncing requires an installed sender
      Returns:
      the previous sender, which may be null

    • currentMode

      public static StackMode currentMode()

    • cycleMode

      public static void cycleMode()
      Advances the selected mode, skipping server-disabled block types. Toggle Permanent remains available. This changes local selection only; it neither sends state nor displays a message.
